absent: Full layouts of irq domain, irq data, irq descriptor and generic chip structures beyond fields touched here.
Lock ordering among global domain mutex, root mutex, descriptor lock, bus lock and generic chip lock.
Domain and generic chip teardown, removal and debug directory lifetime beyond publication.
Meaning of bus token values beyond the wildcard any value and suffix policy details.
Firmware translation and virq allocation mechanics beyond one or two cell reference and descriptor reservation.
Affinity, threading, flow dispatch and timing guarantees beyond hooks and flags shown.
Failure handling for tree insertion, debug allocation and handler installation errors not shown.
Power sequencing guarantees and concurrency rules for suspend resume shutdown walks beyond callback order.

findings.text: Public domain association covers single and bulk binding of virtual numbers to hardware numbers. Bulk form processes a contiguous range by delegating each pair to single association. Single form serializes through the root mutex and returns the locked helper outcome.

Locked association succeeds only when hardware number is inside domain maximum, virtual interrupt has allocated data, and that data has no domain yet. Each violation is warned about and rejected as invalid without side effects.

When a map callback exists its result decides the binding. Permission refusal stays silent while other failures are reported. Any failure clears the tentative assignment and leaves count unchanged. Success increments map count, records reverse mapping and clears the no-request status.

Single association holds the root domain mutex across the whole locked association. Reverse mapping installation requires the caller to already hold that same root mutex, so hierarchy root updates stay serialized.

Reverse mapping is skipped for no-map domains. Otherwise small hardware numbers use a direct array slot with ordered store while larger numbers use tree insertion. The branch boundary is the domain reverse map size.
No-map status requires both build support for the no-map configuration and the domain no-map flag being set. Either condition alone does not qualify.

Domain naming always marks the name as allocated on success and reports memory exhaustion on allocation failure. Base, firmware node and unknown variants all omit bus suffix for the wildcard bus and append numeric bus suffix otherwise.
Firmware node derived names sanitize path separators disliked by the debug filesystem by converting slashes to colons. Optional suffix handling preserves separator semantics with or without a suffix.
Unknown domain names use a process wide atomic counter increased once per call, giving distinct numeric suffixes even under concurrent callers.
Hierarchy marking depends on build. One variant sets the hierarchy flag when an allocation callback is present. The alternate variant is an empty operation that never marks hierarchy.
Domain publication holds the global domain mutex while creating the debug directory and linking into the global domain list. Debug reporting happens after release.

Descriptor instantiation does nothing without sparse interrupt support. With support it attempts reservation of a contiguous range with node affinity derived from firmware node and tolerates failure by assuming preallocation.

Placeholder chips share skip wake behaviour. The none chip reports bad interrupts on acknowledge while the dummy chip provides silent mask and acknowledge. Both use always successful startup and silent shutdown and enable and disable.

Acknowledge through the none chip signals an unconfigured interrupt firing, likely a driver or core bug. The path inspects the descriptor and enters bad interrupt accounting instead of normal completion.

Generic chip mask, unmask, acknowledge and end of interrupt helpers hold the owning chip raw spinlock for the full update of cached mask state and hardware register write, avoiding torn read modify write.
Wake control only accepts interrupts already enabled for wake and rejects others as invalid. Valid calls update the active wake set under lock and report success.

Generic chip allocation reserves a variable length object sized by type count and initializes name, base, register window and flow handler. Domain bulk allocation packages scalar parameters into a record and delegates to the common allocator. Lookup derives chip index by division and validates presence and bounds, with one form returning error pointers and the other collapsing errors to null.

Generic mapping rejects lines marked unused as unsupported and lines already installed as busy. Only the first installation on a chip initializes the mask cache. The per line mask comes from chip callback when present and otherwise defaults to the single bit for the position inside the chip.
First mapping cache initialization on a generic chip holds the chip lock with interrupt state saved. The fragment shows no additional chip locking for later per line info and status updates.

Domain data lookup walks the parent chain until the matching domain in hierarchical builds. In flat builds it performs only one equality test against the top data. Both return null when no match exists.

Domain info installation binds hardware number and chip then attaches flow handler and handler data. Hierarchical form resolves per domain data, defaults missing chip to the none placeholder and reports missing data as not found. Flat form uses global chip and data setters.

Generic line lifecycle moves from free to installed on successful map and back to free on unmap. Unmap clears the installed mark and resets the line to the none chip with empty handler and data. Domain operations bind map plus unmap plus one or two cell translation.

Alternate chip selection scans available chip types in order and installs the first whose type mask overlaps the requested type, updating active chip and dispatch handler. Lack of overlap is reported as invalid.

Suspend time data resolution uses the chip base directly when no domain is attached. With a domain it needs at least one installed line and resolves the lowest installed position to live descriptor data, returning null when none qualify.

Power management walks the global generic chip list. Suspend calls chip suspend then chip specific suspend. Resume calls chip specific resume then chip resume. Shutdown calls only the power off callback. When system sleep is disabled suspend and resume are null operations. Callbacks are published through a syscore object registered at early init.

Architecture interrupt entry is a single mutable hook initially empty. Registration succeeds once and rejects a second attempt as busy. Dispatch wrapper enters interrupt context, swaps register window, invokes the hook, restores the window and exits.
Bad interrupt flow indicates descriptor mismatch or spurious delivery. It reports descriptor details, accounts the event on the current processor and forwards to bad interrupt accounting.
Default handlers provide safe placeholders. The generic action reports no work, chip data handlers do nothing, and startup stub reports zero success.

Duration warning threshold is configured once at boot from a microsecond string. Parse failure and zero value are rejected without enabling. Valid values convert to nanoseconds and enable the static branch.

Thread control uses sequential small values zero through four for run, warned, affinity, forced thread and ready. Resend and start controls are boolean with true meaning resend and force and false meaning no resend and conditional. Internal state flags use distinct low bits from bit zero for autodetect through bit fourteen for sysfs with reserved gaps.

Sparse maximum is integer limit in sparse builds and fixed table size otherwise. Internal state field aliases to a reserved do not touch name. Descriptor check uses bit zero for check and bit one for per cpu, combined into global only and per cpu composites. Multiplexed inter processor log prefix is the ipi mux tag followed by colon and space.

Descriptor lock acquisition validates global versus per cpu kind before locking and rejects mismatches. Valid acquisition optionally takes the bus lock then the descriptor raw spinlock with interrupts saved. A construction helper packages bus flag plus flags plus descriptor pointer for scoped release.

Affinity move pending and pending mask retrieval have active and stub variants. Active move pending reflects set affinity pending state and active retrieval copies the pending mask. Stub variants report no pending move and perform no copy.
Descriptor reference acquisition either attempts a reference counted get that can fail or unconditionally reports success in builds without counting.
Generic domain operations wire map plus unmap plus one or two cell translation. System core operations wire suspend plus resume plus shutdown into a core object registered during early init.
Big endian register helpers delegate to byte ordered thirty two bit input output operations for read and write.
Nested interrupt support reserves two distinct lock classes, one for the interrupt lock and one for request context, applied to virtual interrupts flagged for nested locking during generic mapping.
Generic mask, unmask, acknowledge and end of interrupt operations are exported for chip type tables. Each operates on the per line mask and the register offsets of the active type.
Early init registers the generic chip system core object so suspend plus resume plus shutdown callbacks take part in system wide power transitions.

Mapping and lookup failures signal programming or configuration errors. Missing domain chip reports no device, out of range chip index and type mismatch report invalid, unused line reports unsupported, and double installation reports busy.
